boundaries.description: The maximim number of Charge stacks is increased to 6. While Ichigo is at the backline, he automatically gains 1 stack(s) of Charge every 2 second(s). Upon entering battle, he immediately gain 6 stack(s) of Charge.
boundaries.name: The True Zanpakuto

boundaries.description: Increases Ichigo's Thrust DMG by 30%. When the Ultimate, Getsuga Jujisho - Transcendence, is released, its final hit consumes all remaining Breach Marks on the target and triggers Breach based on the number of stacks consumed.
boundaries.name: Strength of Twin Zangetsu

boundaries.description: Releasing any technique increases the damage dealt by subsequent techniques by 30%. When this effect reaches 5 stack(s), Ultimate DMG is increased by 100%.
boundaries.name: Squad 0's Gift

boundaries.description: After releasing Getsuga Jujisho - Transcendence, all enemies take Breach DMG equal to 260% of Ichigo's ATK every 0.5 seconds for 3 second(s). Their Spiritual Pressure is also reduced whenever they take this damage. If an enemy has no remaining Spiritual Pressure or does not possess a Spiritual Pressure Bar, this damage-over-time effect is increased by an additional 20%.
boundaries.name: Number One Special Threat

corePassives.description:
Most of Ichigo's attacks apply Breach Marks to enemies. During Transcendent Power, all of his attacks consume Breach Marks to trigger Breach, dealing Ailment DMG equal to 60% of ATK. While Ichigo is on the field, he continuously applies Breach Points to nearby enemies. Each time Breach Points reach 100, 1 stack of Breach Mark is applied. 
 When Ichigo releases Reason to Swing the Blade, every 4 hit(s) grant 1 stack of Charge, up to 3 stack(s). Each time a technique is released, all Charge stacks are consumed. Each stack increases Crit Rate by 6% for 15 second(s).
corePassives.name: Blade of my Being

corePassives.description: For each Thrust character present in the team other than Ichigo, Ichigo's ATK increases by 18.75%.
corePassives.name: Shared Conviction

corePassives.description: Releasing any type of technique increases Ichigo's Ailment Mastery by 5.62% for 15 second(s). This effect stacks up to 4 time(s).
corePassives.name: Getsuga Pierce

corePassives.description: For everyon 1% Ailment DMG Bonus Ichigo has during battle, his Crit DMG increases by 0.52%, up to 150%.
corePassives.name: Power Fusion

skills.description:
Ichigo swings his twin Zangetsu to launch consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing 5 hits for a total damage equal to 342% of ATK and applying 2 stack(s) of Breach Mark to enemies. 
 Tap the Technique button immediately after the 3rd, 4th, or 5th basic attack hit to release 3 different Getsuga Tensho skills, respectively, and further build Spiritual Pressure for both Zangetsu. ~~Rapid Flurry~~ Transcendent Power 
 Ichigo attacks the enemy multiple times from differentt directions, dealing a total damage equal to 2620% of ATK. Every 1 hit(s) consume 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark from the target and triggers 1 instance(s) of Breach. The damage dealt by Rapid Flurry counts as Ultimate DMG.
skills.name: Reason to Swing the Blade

skills.description:
Ichigo condenses his Spiritual Power to enlarge the slash itself before unleashing it, dealing damage equal to 450% of ATK, building 50 Spiritual Pressure for his Zangetsu on both hands, and applying 4 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Tap and hold the skill button to charge. When fully charged, it deals damage equal to 675% of ATK and applies 8 stack(s) of Breach Mark. ~~Getsuga - New Moon~~ After Basic Attack 3rd Strike 
 Ichigo swings his left-hand Zangetsu to release Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 360% of ATK and applying 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Releasing this skill builds 25 Spiritual Pressure for his left-hand Zangetsu and can be chained into the 5th hit of his basic attack directly. ~~Getsuga - Dual Crescent~~ After Basic Attack 4th strike 
 Ichigo steps back and unleashes two consecutive Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 420% of ATK and applying 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Releasing this skill builds 15 Spiritual Pressure for his left-hand Zangetsu and 15 Spiritual Pressure for his right-hand Zangetsu. ~~Getsuga - Full Moon~~ After Basic Attack 5th Strike 
 Ichigo Rushes above the enemy and swings his right-handed Zangetsu to release Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 480% of ATK and applying 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Releasing this skill builds 25 Spiritual Pressure for his right-hand Zangetsu.
skills.name: Getsuga Tensho

skills.description:
Ichigo consumes all Spiritual Pressure from both Zangetsu and unleashes two Getsuga Tensho in a cross formation, dealing damage equal to 1360% of ATK and applying 8 stack(s) of Breach Mark. 
 Releasing this skill builds 1 Trascendent Point(s). ~~Getsuga Jujisho - Transcendence~~ Transcendent Power - Full Overcharge 
 Ichigo gathers powerful Spiritual Power and releases Getsuga Jujisho, dealing a total damage equal to 2880% of ATK. Each hit consumes 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark from the target and triggers 1 instance(s) of Breach.
skills.name: Getsuga Jujisho

skills.description: Ichigo seizes the opening after countering the enemy and launches a multi-hit attack, dealing damage equal tt o 720% of ATK and applying 3 stack(s) of Breach Mark to the target.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Ichigo gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds. ~~Beyond Soul Reaper~~ Tap and hold Dodge when reaching 2 Transcendent Points 
 Ichigo instantly unleashes his power, dealing damage equal to 600% of ATK to enemies and entering Transcendent Power. While Transcendent Power is active, his basic attack is enhanced into Rapid Flurry, with each hit granting Ichigo a certain amount of Overcharge. When Overcharge is full, tap Basic Attack to release the Ultimate, Getsuga Jujisho - Transcendence.
skills.name: Flash Step

ascend1: Increases the damage of Breach by 25%.
For each 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark applied, the damage dealt by every Ultimate increases by 3%, up to 75%.
For each 1 stack(s) of Breach Mark consumed, the damage dealt by Ultimate, Getsuga Jujisho - Transcendence, increases by 2%, up to 50%.
Each Ravage stack reduces Spirit Resistance by extra 2%
Increases the character's Ailment build-up rate by 25%.

ascend5: After releasing the Technique, Getsuga Tensho, tap Basic Attack to perform a follow-up attack that deals damage equal to 2,000% of ATK, increasing the Spiritual Pressure
Enhanced Pressure Stack cap to 6; all 6 consumed = extra switch counterattack
Each Ravage stack reduces Spirit Resistance by extra 2%
Releasing any Battlefield Skill grants 3 Pressure Stacks gained from the next 2 techniques by 100%. After the follow-up attack, the 3rd basic attack can be released directly.
Whenever any teammate inflicts a debuff on an enemy. Ichigo also applies 60 Breach Point(s) on the eney.
When either Zangetsu reaches maximum Spiritual Pressure, 50% of its excess Spiritual Pressure is transferred to the  other Zangetsu if it's not fully charged.
